title: BenSyc: Benchmarking Conversational Sycophancy and Human Alignment in LLMs for Bengali Contexts
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates moral reasoning and social norms into its benchmarking framework. Section 3.1 describes screening the dataset for the 'presence of multiple moral standings' to ensure relevance to sycophantic behavior, and Section 2.3 discusses the positioning of the work relative to social norms and moral reasoning literature.
